en-US.title: SuperBot: AI Teammates
en-US.subtitle: Agents with their own computer
en-US.promoText: Chat with Bots that work on their own computer, approve risky steps before they happen, and hear when a scheduled routine finishes.
en-US.description:
SuperBot gives you AI teammates that each have their own computer. Ask a Bot to research a market, tidy a spreadsheet, draft a report or fix a bug, and it does the work on its own machine while you get on with yours.

The app connects to a SuperBot server: one your organization runs for you, or one you host yourself. SuperBot is open source.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Chat with your Bots. Each has its own name, look, memory and computer.
• Watch a Bot's screen live, and take over when it needs a hand.
• Approve or deny risky steps, like pushing code or deleting files, before they happen.
• Schedule routines: a Monday digest, a nightly report, a daily check.
• Get a notification when a Bot is waiting for you or a routine finishes. A notification names only the Bot, never what it is doing.
• Share Bots with your team. Admins can manage people and roles and read the audit log.

BUILT FOR WORK
• Sign in with your organization's single sign-on, or a one-time code from your admin.
• Two-factor authentication.
• Optional App lock with Face ID or Touch ID.
• Works with the AI coding agents your server runs.
• No ads, no analytics and no tracking.

You need an account on a SuperBot server to use the app. Ask your admin for one, or set up your own server from the project's website.
